description: This file is an HTML document that implements a web-based user interface for visualizing and browsing database schemas and data. It includes structured elements, styling, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic interactions such as loading database lists, tables, and table data, as well as handling UI states like loading, errors, and expanding content.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets UI states, and triggers reloading of databases.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's tables list, loading tables if needed.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and populates tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data rows for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for data table display, including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual data cell, handling special formatting for long text, objects, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing cell content to show full data.
